decision_conditions:
The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of planning permission (24/0979/HOT), being 29 July 2024.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
description: Variation of conditions 'U0185992 - Materials' and 'U0185993 - Approved Drawings' of planning permission 24/0979/HOT to make the following amendments; amendment to the configuration of the minimal frame sliding doors to 1 no. sliding door and 1 no. fixed frameless glass panel, up-and-over rooflight over sliding doors extended to align with frameless glass panel below, amendment to the configuration of the glazed doors to garden room to 1 no. garage style glazed door with manual opening system, further refurbishment of the garden room including new slate roof with pitched apex rooflights.
